metadata.title: VETTRI TN AI OS Complete Feature Inventory

categories.name: Executive Office
categories.description: CM Command Center, daily briefing, decision pipelines, and executive copilot interfaces.

categories.name: Ministries
categories.description: Council of ministers, portfolios, and inter-ministerial delivery metrics.

categories.name: Departments
categories.description: Secretariat departments, secretaries, subordinate directorates, and departmental KPIs.

categories.name: District Administration
categories.description: 38 District Collectors, revenue divisions, taluks, blocks, and district performance scorecards.

categories.name: Constituencies
categories.description: 234 Assembly constituencies, MLA profiles, local scheme allocations, and grievances.

categories.name: Government Directory
categories.description: Verified Council of Ministers, IAS, IPS, IFS, district collectors, contacts, and appointments.

categories.name: Projects
categories.description: State infrastructure projects, milestones, budget utilization, delay monitoring, and contractor accountability.

categories.name: Schemes
categories.description: Flagship welfare schemes, beneficiary direct benefit transfer (DBT), saturation, and delivery velocity.

categories.name: Financial Intelligence
categories.description: State revenue receipts, departmental budget burn rates, leakage indicators, and procurement audit analytics.

categories.name: Issue Intelligence
categories.description: Multi-source grievance detection, severity scoring, departmental attribution, and resolution SLAs.

categories.name: CM Action Tracker
categories.description: Executive directives, officer assignment, mandatory acknowledgment, and verified closure sign-offs.

categories.name: Messaging
categories.description: Secure executive chat, departmental channels, issue-linked threads, and priority broadcasts.

categories.name: Meetings
categories.description: High-level cabinet/collector reviews, agenda assembly, live minutes extraction, and action items.

categories.name: AI Agents
categories.description: Executive assistant, directory retrieval, project risk forecaster, and procurement auditor agents with guardrails.

categories.name: Knowledge Hub
categories.description: Government Orders (GOs), statutory Acts, policies, semantic RAG search, and policy amendment tracking.

categories.name: Notifications
categories.description: Real-time critical ticker, multi-channel dispatch, escalation engine, and push notifications.

categories.name: Cross-Cutting & Platform Architecture
categories.description: Responsive layout, collapsible navigation sidebar, state management, and unified design system.

categories.name: Quality Assurance & Automated Testing
categories.description: Pytest backend tests, Vitest frontend tests, schema validation, and CI quality gates.

categories.name: Security, RBAC & Compliance
categories.description: Role-based access control, e-Pramaan SSO readiness, audit logging, and PII protection.

categories.name: Data Governance & Data Quality
categories.description: Master data entity normalization, data quarantine, automated verification, and lineage tracking.

categories.name: DevOps, CI/CD & Deployment
categories.description: GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, GitHub Pages SPA deployment, Docker configuration, and release automation.

categories.name: Accessibility & Inclusive Design
categories.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, screen reader ARIA landmarks, and high contrast.

categories.name: Tamil Localization & Multilingual Operations
categories.description: Bilingual Tamil/English UI, Tamil script search, official terminology, and localized report generation.

categories.name: Operations, Monitoring & Disaster Recovery
categories.description: System health telemetry, service degradation fallbacks, database backup plans, and DR runbooks.

features.title: Chief Minister Command Center Workspace
features.description: Executive dashboard rendering high-level state governance KPIs, flagship health, priority alerts, and actionable decision queues.
features.business_objective: Provide single pane of glass for the Chief Minister and Chief Secretary to monitor statewide operational health.
acceptance_criteria: Render state overall health score gauge
Display 4 priority alert cards with severity tags
List top pending executive decisions with one-click review
Responsive layout across mobile, tablet, and ultra-wide displays
features.next_action: Add real-time telemetry WebSocket streaming when backend server is running

features.title: Daily Executive Morning Briefing
features.description: Curated daily intelligence summary covering overnight law & order incidents, water storage, power demand, and flagship milestones.
features.business_objective: Deliver 5-minute actionable daily brief to executive leadership before morning administrative meetings.
acceptance_criteria: Generate bulleted briefing cards across Key Sectors
Provide audio narration toggle / speech synthesis readiness
Link briefing items directly to responsible Department Secretaries
features.next_action: Enable dynamic PDF briefing pack download

features.title: Executive Decision Pipeline
features.description: Pipeline for tracking Cabinet notes, urgent administrative sanctions, inter-departmental clearances, and executive approvals.
features.business_objective: Accelerate file movement and eliminate bureaucratic bottlenecks on high-priority governance decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Categorize decisions into Urgent, Cabinet, and Financial Sanctions
Show financial implications and sponsoring department
Allow one-click approval, delegation, or return with remarks
features.next_action: Integrate digital e-Sign PKI signature verification

features.title: AI Executive Copilot Integration
features.description: Conversational intelligence copilot answering complex governance questions regarding budgets, schemes, and district performance.
features.business_objective: Empower executive leadership with instant natural language query over Tamil Nadu governance datasets.
acceptance_criteria: Slide-out drawer interface accessible from any screen
Pre-configured executive prompt chips (e.g. Budget variance, Reservoir status)
Ground responses with verified departmental citations
features.next_action: Connect streaming token generation with markdown table rendering

features.title: Executive Action Tracker View
features.description: Comprehensive monitoring view for high-priority Chief Minister instructions with SLA countdowns and departmental ownership.
features.business_objective: Ensure zero dropped instructions issued during CM reviews or field inspections.
acceptance_criteria: Filter actions by status (In Progress, Critical, Completed)
Display assigning authority, target deadline, and responsible Secretary
Highlight overdue actions in red with auto-escalation notice
features.next_action: Add officer auto-SMS notification on SLA breach

features.title: Council of Ministers Directory & Portfolios
features.description: Complete directory of all 35 Cabinet Ministers of Tamil Nadu with verified portfolios, official contact coordinates, and department mappings.
features.business_objective: Maintain accurate record of ministerial responsibility and executive command.
acceptance_criteria: Render 35 verified Cabinet Ministers
Display exact official Tamil and English ministerial designations
Show mapped administrative departments for each minister
Search by minister name, portfolio keyword, or department
features.next_action: Implement dedicated MinistryPortfolioDetail modal (DEF-MIN-01)

features.title: Ministry KPI Performance Heatmap
features.description: Comparative performance matrix tracking scheme delivery, budget expenditure, and grievance resolution velocity across all ministries.
features.business_objective: Identify underperforming portfolios and recognize high-performing ministries with data-driven objectivity.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate departmental KPIs into ministerial score
Color-coded performance tiering (High, Moderate, Needs Attention)
Drill-down to underlying schemes and infrastructure projects
features.next_action: Add quarterly historical trend comparison graphs

features.title: Inter-Ministerial Coordination Pipeline
features.description: Cross-portfolio collaboration tracking for complex initiatives requiring multi-ministerial sanctions (e.g. Industrial Corridors, Water Basins).
features.business_objective: Eliminate inter-ministerial friction and stalled clearances.
acceptance_criteria: Tag multi-department dependencies on key projects
Record joint review decisions and shared accountability
Surface pending inter-departmental clearances to Chief Secretary
features.next_action: Build dedicated joint review workspace

features.title: Secretariat Departments Catalog
features.description: Normalized catalog of Secretariat Departments with parent-child relationships, administrative heads, and official contact information.
features.business_objective: Establish canonical institutional taxonomy for Tamil Nadu governance.
acceptance_criteria: List all primary Secretariat departments (Finance, Home, Revenue, Health, School Education, etc.)
Show Principal Secretary / Additional Chief Secretary in-charge
Provide official Secretariat office location and contact desk
features.next_action: Decompose directorates into dedicated navigation cards (DEF-DEPT-01)

features.title: Department Secretaries & Leadership Roster
features.description: Directory of IAS officers serving as Additional Chief Secretaries, Principal Secretaries, and Special Secretaries across government.
features.business_objective: Enable immediate executive communication with administrative department leadership.
acceptance_criteria: Display cadre, batch, and date of current posting
Provide official @tn.gov.in / @nic.in email and office phone
Track portfolio transitions and acting charges
features.next_action: Sync with latest G.O. Rt postings notifications

features.title: Subordinate Directorates & Commissionerates Hierarchy
features.description: Organizational hierarchy linking Secretariat Departments to executive Commissionerates, Directorates, and Field Agencies.
features.business_objective: Clarify implementation chains between policy formulators and ground execution bodies.
acceptance_criteria: Display hierarchical relationship from Secretariat to Directorate
List Commissioner / Director names and headquarters
Show field division jurisdictions
features.next_action: Expand sub-directorate drilldown tree

features.title: Departmental KPIs & Budget Burn-Rate Tracking
features.description: Telemetry on key departmental performance indicators, scheme disbursement speed, and financial budget utilization.
features.business_objective: Monitor departmental operational efficiency and identify spending laggards before fiscal year-end.
acceptance_criteria: Chart planned vs actual budget utilization percentage
Track core sector metrics (e.g. school enrollment, bed occupancy, road repair kms)
Alert when departmental spending falls behind quarterly milestone by >15%
features.next_action: Add automated monthly budget variance alerts

features.title: 38 District Collectors Directory & Profiles
features.description: Verified directory of all 38 District Collectors across Tamil Nadu with official coordinates, district headquarters, and office locations.
features.business_objective: Provide immediate executive connection to all district administration leaders.
acceptance_criteria: 38 verified District Collectors with official names and designations
Verified official collector@nic.in email addresses and Collectorate phone desks
Filter by geographic zone (North, South, West, Central, Coastal)
features.next_action: Add Collectorate control room emergency hotline toggles

features.title: District Performance Scorecards & Heatmap
features.description: Interactive geographic map and scoring matrix evaluating all 38 districts across health, education, infrastructure, and public grievance redressal.
features.business_objective: Foster healthy competitive federalism and direct state interventions to lagging districts.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive SVG/Leaflet Tamil Nadu district map with color-coded score tiers
District ranking table with sorting by KPI category
Direct link to Collector Command View from any selected district
features.next_action: Add taluk-level geospatial heat layers

features.title: Revenue Divisions, Taluks & Blocks Administration
features.description: Administrative sub-district hierarchy detailing Revenue Divisional Officers (RDOs), Tahsildars, and Block Development Officers (BDOs).
features.business_objective: Support granular administrative supervision down to revenue village and block panchayat level.
acceptance_criteria: Detail sub-divisions and taluks within selected district
Display critical disaster management resources per taluk
Track public grievance resolution by revenue division
features.next_action: Populate complete 312 taluk Tahsildar roster

features.title: 234 Assembly Constituencies & MLA Roster
features.description: Directory of all 234 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly constituencies, elected Members of Legislative Assembly (MLAs), and political representations.
features.business_objective: Bridge executive governance with legislative accountability and local citizen representation.
acceptance_criteria: Search by constituency name or district
Display MLA name, party affiliation, and contact office
Map constituency boundaries to revenue taluks
features.next_action: Build dedicated AssemblyConstituenciesView component with full 234 MLA roster (DEF-CONST-01)

features.title: MLA Constituency Development Scheme (MLACDS) Tracking
features.description: Financial and physical execution tracking of MLACDS allocations (₹3 Crore per constituency annually).
features.business_objective: Ensure timely sanction and quality execution of grassroots community works proposed by MLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Track financial sanction vs expenditure per constituency
Categorize approved works (roads, drinking water, school infrastructure)
Flag unspent balances nearing fiscal closure
features.next_action: Add geo-tagged photo verification for completed MLACDS assets

features.title: Constituency Grievance & Issue Intelligence
features.description: Aggregation of public petitions, CM Helpline 1100 grievances, and field issues mapped by Assembly Constituency.
features.business_objective: Equip MLAs and District Collectors with localized issue hotspots.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate grievance volume by constituency
Categorize top citizen complaints (drinking water, electricity, civic drainage)
Highlight constituencies with SLA resolution delays
features.next_action: Enable MLA dashboard view for constituency petition tracking

features.title: Verified Council of Ministers Entity Store
features.description: Cryptographically validated and official-source-verified dataset of all 35 Cabinet Ministers of Tamil Nadu.
features.business_objective: Eliminate unverified or fictional ministerial entries across the entire platform.
acceptance_criteria: 100% verified against tn.gov.in official council of ministers portal
Verified portfolios, official secretariat phone numbers, and official emails
Strict schema separation between Person, Office, and Appointment
features.next_action: Establish weekly automated hash verification against tn.gov.in

features.title: IAS Cadre Postings & Batch Roster
features.description: Verified roster of Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers in Tamil Nadu cadre with batch, current posting, and administrative department.
features.business_objective: Maintain definitive civil service leadership postings for state administration.
acceptance_criteria: Accurate batch year, current designation, and department
Separation of substantive rank from officiating appointment
Official @nic.in / @tn.gov.in contact addresses
features.next_action: Sync with G.O. Ms postings feed

features.title: IPS Police Leadership & Commissionerates Roster
features.description: Verified roster of Indian Police Service (IPS) leadership, including DGP, Police Commissioners, Zonal IGs, Range DIGs, and District SPs.
features.business_objective: Enable immediate executive coordination for law & order and public safety.
acceptance_criteria: Verified Director General of Police (DGP) and City Police Commissioners
District Superintendents of Police (SPs) mapped to 38 revenue districts
Official police headquarters and control room coordinates
features.next_action: Add State Police Master Control Room direct dispatch link

features.title: IFS Forest Service Leadership Roster
features.description: Verified leadership roster of Indian Forest Service (IFS) officers, including Principal Chief Conservator of Forests (PCCF) and Wildlife Wardens.
features.business_objective: Support environmental governance, wildlife conservation, and forest fire crisis management.
acceptance_criteria: PCCF and Chief Wildlife Warden official coordinates
Territorial Conservators of Forests mapped to forest circles
Official Department of Environment, Climate Change and Forests contacts
features.next_action: Integrate forest circle fire alert contact routing

features.title: Secretariat & Department Heads Roster
features.description: Exhaustive directory of Heads of Departments (HODs), Directors, and Managing Directors of State Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).
features.business_objective: Connect policy execution to statutory agency and state enterprise leadership.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog of statutory boards (TIDCO, SIPCOT, TWAD, TANGEDCO)
Verified Managing Director names, office addresses, and official contacts
Direct linking to parent Secretariat administrative departments
features.next_action: Add board meeting calendar sync

features.title: District Collectors Verified Contact Store
features.description: Canonical dataset of 38 District Collectors with NIC-verified emails, official camp office phones, and Collectorate addresses.
features.business_objective: Provide verified point of contact for every administrative district in Tamil Nadu.
acceptance_criteria: All 38 District Collectors verified with official @nic.in email format
Office and camp office phone desk numbers
Collectorate address and district headquarters pin code
features.next_action: Enable one-click encrypted SMS dispatch

features.title: Multi-Faceted Directory Search & Filtering
features.description: Fast client-side and server-side search indexing across official names, departments, designations, districts, and services.
features.business_objective: Find any state official or department within 200 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Instant search by name, department, designation, or district
Filter chips for Ministers, IAS, IPS, IFS, and District Collectors
Tamil script name and English phonetic search support
features.next_action: Add autocomplete suggestions for common bureaucratic designations

features.title: Data Integrity Quarantine Engine
features.description: Isolation and quarantine registry for unverified, obsolete, or fictional officer records preventing pollution of production directory.
features.business_objective: Guarantee that unverified records cannot appear in active searches or executive workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Quarantine isolated dataset (quarantinedOfficials) preserving audit trail
Strict quarantine reason logging (e.g. unverified, fictional, superseded)
Quarantined records excluded from all production search indexes and AI prompts
features.next_action: Automate anomaly detection for newly submitted contact updates

features.title: Source Verification & Order Reference Tracking
features.description: Grounding of every officer appointment and contact record to official Government Orders (G.O.), Gazette notifications, or official portals.
features.business_objective: Provide legal defensibility and provenance for all directory information.
acceptance_criteria: Record specific G.O. Ms / G.O. Rt number or official tn.gov.in URL for every appointment
Verification timestamp and verifier role metadata
Display verification badge in directory UI
features.next_action: Link directly to full PDF text of appointing Government Orders

features.title: Officer Transfer & Appointment History Model
features.description: Historical tenure tracking recording start dates, end dates, previous postings, and transfer orders.
features.business_objective: Track administrative continuity and institutional memory across officer transfers.
acceptance_criteria: Support historical appointments table with start_date and end_date
Record reason for transfer (routine reshuffle, promotion, superannuation)
Link past projects and actions to officer during their tenure window
features.next_action: Build visual timeline of past postings in officer profile modal

features.title: Normalized Department & Office Hierarchy Model
features.description: Relational entity model separating Person (individual officer) from Office (post/chair) and Appointment (tenure).
features.business_objective: Prevent broken data relationships when officers are transferred or promoted.
acceptance_criteria: Offices retain unique ID regardless of occupant
Appointments reference Person ID and Office ID
Prevent orphan contacts when an officer demits office
features.next_action: Enforce foreign key constraints in backend PostgreSQL migration

features.title: Direct Official Email & Phone Verification
features.description: Syntax and domain validation enforcing official government email patterns (@tn.gov.in, @nic.in, @ips.gov.in).
features.business_objective: Ensure communications reach genuine government endpoints and prevent unauthorized personal inboxes.
acceptance_criteria: Regex validation rejecting commercial webmail (gmail, yahoo, hotmail) for official records
Verification of official landline STD area codes (e.g. 044 for Chennai Secretariat)
Flag invalid or unverified formats during ingestion
features.next_action: Add automated SMTP MX and bounce-back verification script

features.title: Contact Export & Digital VCard Generation
features.description: Export of verified official directory contacts into standard VCard (.vcf) and CSV formats for executive devices.
features.business_objective: Allow authorized executive staff to sync verified contact cards directly to secured mobile phones.
acceptance_criteria: Export single official or filtered group (e.g. all 38 District Collectors)
VCard 3.0 standard compliance with official designation, phone, and email
Sanitize private notes from exported cards
features.next_action: Implement one-click batch VCard download for Cabinet Ministers

features.title: Quick Dial & Secure Message Dispatch Integration
features.description: Direct tel: and mailto: link triggers with pre-populated subject lines linking to active governance issues or actions.
features.business_objective: Enable zero-friction communication from decision screens to responsible officers.
acceptance_criteria: Click-to-call link for mobile executive users
Pre-formatted official email draft referencing relevant CM Action ID or Scheme ID
Integration with platform internal secure messaging
features.next_action: Add VoIP desktop call launcher support

features.title: Directory Anomaly & Stale Record Audit Alerting
features.description: Automated detection of vacant offices, overlapping appointments, or records unverified for >90 days.
features.business_objective: Proactively flag directory decay before it impacts executive operations.
acceptance_criteria: Flag offices with no active appointment
Detect conflicting multiple appointments for a single substantive office
Generate audit defect cards for records exceeding re-verification cadence
features.next_action: Integrate automated monthly re-verification email reminders to Department nodal officers

features.title: Public vs Internal Contact Access Filtering
features.description: Role-based visibility partitioning between public RTI-disclosable contacts and internal executive hotline numbers.
features.business_objective: Protect operational executive numbers while ensuring transparent public administration coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Public view shows official office desk numbers and nodal officer emails
Executive persona unlocks direct camp office numbers and emergency wireless call-signs
Audited access logging for privileged contact views
features.next_action: Enforce field-level encryption for internal executive hotlines

features.title: Infrastructure Projects Portfolio & Tracking
features.description: High-value state infrastructure portfolio tracking (Metro Rail, Highways, SIPCOT Parks, Desalination Plants, Tidel Parks).
features.business_objective: Ensure timely delivery of mega infrastructure investments driving Tamil Nadu's $1 Trillion economy goal.
acceptance_criteria: Track physical completion percentage against financial expenditure
Display executing department, contracting consortium, and supervising engineer
Categorize projects by sector (Transport, Energy, Water, Industrial)
features.next_action: Build interactive Gantt timeline component (DEF-PROJ-01)

features.title: Milestone Timeline & Monsoon Delay Monitoring
features.description: Milestone tracking calibrated for Tamil Nadu climate windows, flagging earthwork/paving risks ahead of Northeast Monsoon.
features.business_objective: Prevent monsoon-induced infrastructure project washouts and contract claims.
acceptance_criteria: Track critical path milestones against seasonal weather windows
Auto-flag outdoor civil works scheduled during October-December monsoon months
Record verified milestone completion evidence
features.next_action: Add Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) rainfall forecast overlay

features.title: Project Expenditure vs Budget Allocation Analysis
features.description: Continuous financial audit comparing revised administrative sanctions against actual contractor disbursements and utilization certificates.
features.business_objective: Prevent cost overruns and unauthorized scope expansions.
acceptance_criteria: Display original sanctioned cost, revised estimate, and cumulative expenditure
Highlight projects with cost escalations >10%
Track contractor billing turnaround and pending payments
features.next_action: Integrate automated contractor billing ledger sync

features.title: Project Risk & Critical Path Analysis
features.description: Automated identification of land acquisition impediments, utility shifting bottlenecks, and environmental clearance delays.
features.business_objective: Proactively resolve inter-agency friction before projects fall into critical delay.
acceptance_criteria: Risk scoring matrix (High, Medium, Low) based on delayed milestones
Identify blocking department (e.g. TANGEDCO utility shifting, Revenue land acquisition)
Generate automated Chief Secretary escalation note
features.next_action: Enable AI critical path simulation on delayed milestone updates

features.title: Flagship Welfare Schemes Inventory & Beneficiary Tracking
features.description: Real-time monitoring of Tamil Nadu's marquee welfare programs: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam, Pudhumai Penn, Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme, and Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam.
features.business_objective: Ensure inclusive saturation and timely benefit delivery to targeted citizen beneficiaries.
acceptance_criteria: Track total enrolled beneficiaries against demographic target
Display monthly Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) disbursement status
Monitor daily operational coverage (e.g. morning breakfast served count)
features.next_action: Add district-level beneficiary heat breakdown

features.title: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Disbursement & Failure Analytics
features.description: Telemetry on Aadhaar-enabled bank disbursements, identifying transaction failure rates and banking correspondent bottlenecks.
features.business_objective: Achieve zero delay in welfare cash transfers reaching women and vulnerable families.
acceptance_criteria: Track successful vs failed bank transaction percentages
Categorize failure causes (NPCI mapping, inactive account, IFSC error)
Alert District Collectors on clusters of bank transfer rejections
features.next_action: Integrate automated re-try queue with State Level Bankers' Committee (SLBC)

features.title: Scheme Saturation & Last-Mile Coverage Analysis
features.description: Demographic cross-referencing to discover eligible households missing from welfare rolls in tribal blocks and urban slums.
features.business_objective: Ensure complete saturation of welfare safety net for disadvantaged communities.
acceptance_criteria: Estimate saturation gap percentage by district and block
Cross-reference ration card database with scheme beneficiary lists
Highlight un-enrolled vulnerable pockets for targeted outreach camps
features.next_action: Add field surveyor mobile sync for doorstep enrollment

features.title: Scheme Grievance Redressal Velocity
features.description: Dedicated tracking of beneficiary appeals, rejected applications, and delayed disbursements.
features.business_objective: Provide rapid redressal for citizens encountering administrative friction.
acceptance_criteria: Track incoming appeals and average resolution time (SLA target <7 days)
Categorize appeal types (document verification, eligibility dispute)
Auto-escalate cases delayed beyond 15 days to Revenue Divisional Officer
features.next_action: Add SMS appeal status updates to applicants

features.title: State Revenue & Tax Receipts Monitoring
features.description: Daily and monthly tracking of State's Own Tax Revenue (Commercial Taxes, State Excise, Stamp Duty & Registration, Motor Vehicles).
features.business_objective: Monitor fiscal health and ensure revenue realization matches budget estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Compare actual tax receipts against monthly targets
Analyze year-over-year revenue growth trajectories
Highlight shortfall sectors (e.g. property registration dips, fuel GST trends)
features.next_action: Add economic indicator correlation models (inflation, industrial power consumption)

features.title: Departmental Expenditure & Budget Burn-Rate
features.description: Monitoring of revenue and capital expenditure against sanctioned Demand for Grants across all departments.
features.business_objective: Ensure orderly fiscal execution and prevent March-rush budget exhaustion.
acceptance_criteria: Visualize budget burn rate across Q1 to Q4
Differentiate between establishment (salary/pension) and developmental capital expenditure
Flag departments with <50% capital expenditure allocation by Q3
features.next_action: Integrate automated IFHRMS treasury feed

features.title: Revenue Leakage & Procurement Audit Intelligence
features.description: Statistical anomaly detection flagging suspicious procurement tenders, single-bidder patterns, and mining/mineral transport revenue leaks.
features.business_objective: Safeguard public resources and enforce the Tamil Nadu Transparency in Tenders Act.
acceptance_criteria: Flag tenders with repetitive bid rings or abnormal price variance (>25% over estimate)
Detect mineral vehicle toll mismatches indicating illegal quarrying
Generate automated procurement audit risk cards
features.next_action: Add automated GeM / TNTenders API connector

features.title: CAG & Local Fund Audit Compliance Tracker
features.description: Tracking compliance and remediation for audit paras raised by the Comptroller & Auditor General (CAG) and Public Accounts Committee (PAC).
features.business_objective: Eliminate persistent audit objections and enforce administrative accountability.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog outstanding CAG audit paragraphs by department and year
Track Action Taken Notes (ATNs) submitted to Assembly PAC
Alert Secretaries on audit paras pending explanation for >6 months
features.next_action: Add PAC meeting recommendation action item linkage

features.title: Multi-Source Issue Ingestion & Geo-Tagging
features.description: Unified grievance and incident ingestion synthesizing CM Helpline 1100, field inspections, emergency calls, and news intelligence.
features.business_objective: Establish unified situational awareness of citizen grievances and critical ground incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest grievances with standardized categorization and latitude/longitude
Map issues onto 38 districts and specific revenue taluks
Detect emerging spatial incident clusters (e.g. localized drinking water outage)
features.next_action: Integrate automated social media / citizen video feed analyzer

features.title: Issue Severity & Urgency Scoring Matrix
features.description: Automated priority scoring evaluating public safety risk, affected population scale, and infrastructure criticality.
features.business_objective: Ensure critical P0 life-safety and flood issues immediately reach top leadership.
acceptance_criteria: Four-tier severity classification: P0 (Emergency), P1 (Critical), P2 (Major), P3 (Routine)
Automated urgency escalation for public health outbreaks or bridge structural alerts
Display prominent severity badges on executive feeds
features.next_action: Calibrate dynamic scoring based on weather alerts

features.title: Departmental Accountability & Attribution
features.description: Direct algorithmic mapping of detected issues to responsible Secretariat department, HOD, and field executive engineer.
features.business_objective: Eliminate jurisdictional confusion and buck-passing between departments.
acceptance_criteria: Automated department mapping based on grievance category taxonomy
Designate lead department and assisting departments for complex incidents
Track transfer disputes between departments with Chief Secretary arbitration
features.next_action: Build automatic jurisdiction boundary polygon checker

features.title: Public Sentiment & Media Signal Tracking
features.description: Monitoring of public sentiment trends across regional media, social platforms, and community town halls.
features.business_objective: Identify citizen dissatisfaction patterns before they escalate into statewide unrest.
acceptance_criteria: Sentiment scoring (Positive, Neutral, Negative) across governance sectors
Surface trending civic topics across Tamil news headlines
Alert CMO communications team on sudden negative sentiment spikes
features.next_action: Add Tamil language NLP sentiment classifier

features.title: Executive Order & Directive Issuance
features.description: Creation and dispatch of binding Chief Minister directives with official tracking numbers, priority levels, and completion deadlines.
features.business_objective: Formalize verbal instructions into tracked executive commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Generate unique CM Directive identifier (e.g. CMD-2026-XXXX)
Attach background briefing note, required deliverables, and target deadline
Classify directive type (Policy, Field Inspection, Emergency Relief)
features.next_action: Add official digital seal generation

features.title: Officer Assignment & Mandatory Acknowledgment
features.description: Automated routing of CM directives to responsible Secretaries, Collectors, and SPs with cryptographic read-receipt logging.
features.business_objective: Enforce administrative accountability and establish clear proof of delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Direct dispatch to designated officer's secure inbox and mobile SMS
Mandatory acknowledgment window (<4 hours for P0 emergencies)
Automated escalation to Chief Secretary if unacknowledged
features.next_action: Add OTP-verified acknowledgment flow

features.title: Action Item Status Tracking & SLA Escalations
features.description: Continuous countdown monitoring of action deliverables with color-coded SLA timers (Normal, At Risk, Overdue).
features.business_objective: Prevent directives from stalling in inter-departmental review loops.
acceptance_criteria: Real-time countdown timer to completion deadline
Interim milestone reporting for multi-week directives
Automated daily escalation summary delivered to Chief Secretary
features.next_action: Add WhatsApp automated reminder webhook

features.title: Independent Verification & Closure Sign-Off
features.description: Multi-stage sign-off requiring verified field evidence (photos, inspection reports, citizen sign-off) before an action is closed.
features.business_objective: Ensure directives are genuinely executed on the ground rather than cosmetically closed on paper.
acceptance_criteria: Require uploading of geo-tagged inspection evidence before requesting closure
Independent verification check by CMO Special Inspection Cell
Final executive closure approval by Chief Minister / Chief Secretary
features.next_action: Add third-party citizen verification callback system

features.title: Executive Direct Secure Chat
features.description: Encrypted peer-to-peer real-time messaging between Chief Minister, Ministers, Chief Secretary, and District Collectors.
features.business_objective: Enable rapid, confidential executive decision-making during crisis events.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end encrypted messaging interface with officer online presence
Rich attachment support for official PDF notes and high-resolution ground photos
Searchable historical message archive by officer or keyword
features.next_action: Enable voice note recording with automated speech-to-text transcription
